subject: ExplosiveKnockback Design Version 0.2.0
decision: opened and locked 0.2.0 (MINOR) with 14 new bars: carried_thing_own_arc, collision_bruise_by_size, nine blast_show_* bars, gas_shoves_pawn_on_pit_cover, no_impact_without_contact, rebound_goes_shorter; every 0.1.0 bar kept
reasons: Divergent additions from his own words of 2026-11-24 (OWNER:1795565769863524396), opened as a MINOR on the obvious reading: the carried thing on its own arc, collision bruises by size, our own blast show, and the polish lines the Conductor judged relevant. He ruled the version himself: "Both of these re-openings will of course go to the NEXT version of the mod." (OWNER:1795565863812726726). No recorded evidence argues against 0.2.0 or against these bars (his Evidence-for-Ask ruling, 2026-11-15). Two readings are the Designer's and his to undo: 'size' in the bruise rule is the creature's mass, and the same rule covers a pawn that stops a thrown pawn.
